capabilities: Step the base font size from a pane-header button (left-click up, right-click down)
Toggle between light and dark themes from a pane-header button
Run the same actions from three commands
Reflect live Obsidian settings on the button states
Apply a theme-dark or theme-light class to the document element
extras: Not yet in the community directory; submission is pending, so it must be installed manually from release files. The README includes detailed disclosures (no network use, no stored data, no telemetry).
motivation: The README says it is built for the Mimir learning vault.
problem: Changing the base font size or switching between light and dark requires opening Settings → Appearance, which is slow when done often.
summary: Pane-header controls that step Obsidian's base font size through three steps and toggle the light/dark theme without opening settings.
